Carla (Auditor): Request: need an evidence pack for service account `infra-backfill-sa` removed 2025-08-12. Deliverables: deprovision event, credential revocation proof, KMS grant revoke or key rotation proof, any related vuln/incident refs, UTF-8 exportable logs, checksums, and a signed manifest. Deadline: next Tue EOD.

Alice (Security): We'll collect CloudTrail events + k8s audit slice + IAM change commit/PR. Will redact personal data.

Ben (Platform): Staging plan: export CloudTrail filtered by PrincipalId, dump KMS CloudTrail events, run `aws kms describe-key` for associated aliases, and list KMS grants. Artifacts -> s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1778888888/.

Evan (SRE): Deprovision job run-20250812-09f3 logs available. I'll include kube-apiserver audit lines showing the delete.

Fiona (Compliance PM): I'll produce manifest.json with path, sha256, collected_by, collected_at, and collection_method. I will GPG-sign manifest and upload manifest.json.asc.

Carla (Auditor): Manifest must include origin (cli vs automated), UTC timestamps, approver of deprovision, and explicit mapping showing when all active credentials were removed. Also need proof that any KMS grants to the SA were revoked. Signed attestations acceptable.

Ben (Platform): We'll add a CSV mapping: resource,event_ts,event_id,artifact_path. Example row: `access-key,2025-08-12T09:02:11Z,evt-0abc,s3://...`.

Alice (Security): Commands we'll run for reproducibility: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=infra-backfill-sa --start-time 2025-08-12T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-08-13T00:00:00Z` and `kubectl get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=infra-backfill-sa -n infra --since=48h`.

evidence-bot: Deprovision job uploaded: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1778888888/deprov-run-20250812.log (sha256: d1e5f...).

Evan (SRE): Incident link: INC-2025-324 referenced this SA. I'll export ticket PDF and timestamp match.

Fiona (Compliance PM): Manifest and signature scheduled to be uploaded by 2025-08-18T23:59:00Z. I'll email public key to auditor.

Carla (Auditor): OK. When uploaded please post checksums here and confirm signature verification method. Thanks. :thumbsup:
